title: Framing Joint Proposals and Mediation Requests

sections.content: You know *recomendar que* and *aconsejar que* with the present subjunctive from B1 Unit 4, past subjunctive sequence of tenses (*quería que vinieras*) from B1 Unit 38, and press reporting verbs such as *señalar que* from C1 Unit 4. In formal mediation and negotiation protocols, directives are framed as institutional proposals or procedural requests using *proponer que*, *sugerir que*, *solicitar que* and *instar a que* ('to urge that'). When one party or the mediator asks another subject to act, the *que* clause takes the subjunctive. When the same party commits to its own action, an infinitive is used (*proponemos flexibilizar*), and when a verb such as *señalar que* or *indicar que* simply states a verified fact from the table, it takes the indicative.

sections.title: Influence vs Statement in Mediation
rows: El mediador propone que las dos partes presenten una contrapropuesta. (The mediator proposes that the two sides submit a counter-proposal.)
La comisión insta a que la contraparte flexibilice su postura. (The commission urges the counterpart to make its position more flexible.)
Proponemos acercar posturas antes del viernes. (We propose bringing positions closer before Friday.)
La portavoz señala que la mediación avanza con calma. (The spokesperson points out that the mediation is progressing calmly.)

items.spanish: El mediador solicita que cada delegación designe a un portavoz.
items.english: The mediator requests that each delegation appoint a spokesperson.

items.spanish: La presidencia sugirió que las dos partes mediaran en la disputa local.
items.english: The presidency suggested that the two sides mediate in the local dispute.

items.spanish: Les instamos a que acerquen posturas en torno al calendario.
items.english: We urge you to bring your positions closer regarding the schedule.

items.spanish: El informe indica que la contraparte ya presentó su contrapropuesta.
items.english: The report indicates that the counterpart has already submitted its counter-proposal.

sections.content: Keep the preposition *a* in *instar a que* + subjunctive (*instaron a que se firmara*), never bare *instar que*. Watch the contrast with verbs of reporting: *sugerir que* or *solicitar que* asks someone to act (subjunctive), whereas *señalar que* or *indicar que* reports an existing fact (indicative).
